entries.zh: 领兵；接收兵员（领受兵丁）
entries.en: to receive soldiers; to take charge of troops (recibir soldados)

entries.zh: 粮户征收贡赋、收纳税粮（受封征地者收贡）
entries.en: the encomendero to receive the tributes; to collect grain-tax as a tax household/captain
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99）；「糧戶」对 encomendero 收贡系赋役制度词推断，L/H 义合。

entries.zh: 蒙恩、承恩；深蒙恩泽（渥恩）
entries.en: to receive favor or kindness; to be deeply favored (recibir el favor)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕暗中勒索人财、收受贿赂（暗绞人）
entries.en: to take bribes (cohechos); to extort gain from people covertly
entries.notes: 汉字栏末标 [残]；「暗绞人」与 cohecho（贿赂、私弊）音义互证大体可通，惟字面残损不全。

entries.en: to receive the favor (merced); to be beholden for kindness or a gift
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99）；沐恩与 recibir la merced（受恩惠）互证清晰，字义不受影响。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕承接下来、接手（承接他人已做之后的事）
entries.en: to take over or receive something after it is done; to carry on from another's hands
entries.notes: 西语限定语残损难通读（…como el afs. que venel offi.）；义从 H「承下手」与音写 sin-e-chiu 定为承接下手之事。

entries.zh: 收定（收定金、凭信之物）；收作凭据
entries.en: to receive as a token or pledge; to take earnest money (recibir en señal)
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99），第二音节音写分裂存疑；收定与 recibir en señal（收作凭信）义合。

entries.zh: 暂屈、受屈；一时忍受委屈屈辱
entries.en: to suffer wrongs for a short time; to endure humiliation temporarily (bend for a while)
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99）；暂屈/受屈两读并见，与 recibir agravios por poco tiempo 义合。

entries.zh: 授受；一授一受、交付与接收
entries.en: to give and receive (mutually); [Sp. headword garbled, conjecturally "recibir los yndios"]
entries.notes: 西语 log yndoy 难确读、校读拟为 los yndios 而与「授受」仅部分相合，故存疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕受赐；接受赏赐馈赠（并兼言施与）
entries.en: to receive gifts or bestowals (and to give); to accept bounty
entries.notes: 西语限定语残损、dadivas obras he dar 连读未确证；义从 L/H（受赐）推断。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕呼鸟之声（鸟哨、呼引小鸟）；「烏四」字面难全解
entries.en: a call or lure for a little bird (bird-call, decoy call); characters partially damaged
entries.notes: 西语限定语残损；汉字「烏四」第二字与音写仅注一音 bū 难互证，义从 reclamo（呼鸟、媒鸟）推断。

entries.zh: 鸟媒、呼鸟之鸟；「鳥四」第二字与音注 bū 不合，字面存疑
entries.en: a decoy bird, a bird kept to call others (reclamo); second character anomalous against the phonetic gloss
entries.notes: 汉字「鳥四」第二字读不出 bū 音、疑有讹字；义从西语 reclamo 与音写 chiàu-bū 拟为鸟媒。

entries.en: to lean against, nestle upon the arm (reclinarse, subirse al brazo)
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99），中间音写小记号难辨；字面「靠」清晰、字义不受影响。

entries.en: to take in, gather or secure a place (recoger algún lugar)

entries.zh: 收脚；收敛（缩手收脚、检点改过）
entries.en: to draw in one's feet, restrain oneself; to mend one's ways (recogerse, enmendarse)
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99）；收脚与 recogerse/enmendarse（收敛、改过）义合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕拢起额前鬓发；鬓发（字面「鬢髭」）
entries.en: to gather or tie up the hair of the forehead (front hair); temple-hair and moustache (characters partially damaged)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标 [残]，第二字「髭」与音写 gui 不相合；义从西语（收拢额前头发）与音写 pin（鬢）推断。

entries.en: to raise soldiers, muster troops (recoger soldados)
entries.notes: 闽南栏一处调号污损（T99）；起兵与 recoger soldados（起集兵员）互证清晰，字义不受影响。
